photo_note: Our lookbook images are digitally enhanced, so your set will look a little different in person. Length, shape and color will vary based on your natural nails and the shades you choose. Set 80 is a short Gel-X set with art on 1 or 2 nails, depending on the style.

terms: Set 80 includes a short Gel-X full set with nail art on 1 or 2 nails, depending on the style. Lookbook photos are digitally enhanced and for reference only. Final results vary with your nail length, shape and color choice.
Longer length, additional nail art, or designs outside the lookbook are priced separately. Removal of existing product is an additional charge.
Have your own inspo? Bring it in! Your artist will take a look, and if it fits the Set 80 vibe, we’ll make it work. If not, we’ll let you know the price before we start.
ended_message: Set 80 has wrapped for now. Thank you for the love! See what’s new on The Latest, or book your next set.
